title: Dan P NDE 4782/4633 NDE 4633
content:
4782 The day after returning from a business trip, at midnight, I had a massive heart attack. Later, the Doctor told me they call it the widow maker; it was the one you don't want. I had a total blockage of the LAD with ventricular fib. My wife summoned the ambulance, and after loading me, the emergency medical technician placed a nitro pill under my tongue. That was the last thing I remembered. I was taken to the emergency room. The staff hit me twice with the defibrillator paddles. Then I was put on a helicopter and flown to the hospital. Then I underwent angioplasty and received a stint in my heart. I was unconscious for two weeks, breathing with a respirator. The heart ejection fraction was down to about 10% and my son in law, a physician, gave my chances less than that. I stayed a total of 39 days in the hospital. I now have a defibrillator in my chest and returned to work after six months. I began writing about it on a blog, www.Fixedhearts.blogspot.com. When I awoke, I told the story of my trip to ‘heaven’. Although I had two weeks of morphine dreams, the death experience was very separate and very real. I was thrilled with the experience and anxious to share. For a few brief moments, I found myself in what seemed like ‘heaven's front yard’. I was aware of a door to the right. Jesus (I am specific here) was talking to someone standing in front of me. I was amazed at the grace, unconditional love, and freedom I was feeling. This person had not been a Christian (by religion, or birth) on earth, but was given the opportunity to choose now. I thought this was fantastic. I did not choose to return, but I left there and returned to earth. I don't remember being asked to choose, but now 8 months later, some of the details are vague. It was crystal clear to me then, and I thought I would never forget every second and every detail. Since I couldn't speak or even write for a long time afterward, the details suffer
